reviews.text:
We can't thank Rich and Paula enough for looking after our sidesurfing five year old Goldendoodle, Wilma, while we were away for 12 nights over the summer. She had the best time.

From the very first meeting, it was obvious just how much Rich and Paula love and care for the dogs in their home. They are calm, kind, caring people who genuinely want every dog to feel happy and secure. Before Wilma's stay, they took the time to learn all about her, including her likes and dislikes, her routine, and even where she prefers to sleep. It was clear they wanted to make sure she felt completely at home.

Their garden is safe and secure, and we were particularly impressed by the CCTV covering every angle of the outdoor space, allowing them to keep a close eye on the dogs at all times.

After our first visit, we felt as though we'd known them for years. We then booked an overnight trial stay, and Wilma practically dragged us down the drive and to the gate, desperate to get inside. That alone told us everything we needed to know!

She had a fantastic first night. Rich and Paula even left doors open so she could find her favourite place to settle. Wilma chose a spot by the front door and slept so soundly that Rich briefly worried she'd somehow escaped during the night. Knowing Wilma's talent for opening doors, it wasn't impossible! But she was fast asleep.

During her longer stay, we received regular updates, photos and videos showing her out on adventures, making new friends and clearly enjoying her own holiday.

We had actually considered not going away this year because Wilma had only ever stayed with one boarder since she was a puppy. After she retired, we didn't think we'd find anyone who could care for her quite so well. Rich and Paula proved us wrong.

We genuinely couldn't recommend them enough. They treat every dog as if it's their own, and it's no surprise they have such happy hounds in their care. Thank you both for taking such wonderful care of our girl.

Couldn't recommend Richard and Paula enough! We make a point of taking our dog here even when she could be with us as we know she has such a good time and is cared for. Have never felt the need to look for anywhere else
Excellent care for my dog from the happy hound Haven team

Paula and Richard have been totally magnificent with our dog Kali.They have not just gone the extra mile, more like the extra hundred miles to meet Kali's additional needs following an injury.
We have have had daily updates and pictures  from them which kept our minds at rest.
Kali has clearly had a fabulous time with them again.
I can't recommend them highly enough.

Ched loved his stay at happy hounds haven! He had a trial night and settled so well before his week stay! He loved his time and we received daily photos and updates meaning we could relax and enjoy our holiday, knowing Ched was so settled and loving life on his holiday too! He will definitely be back, even tried to book a return visit at pick up! Thanks so much!

We’re so happy we found these amazing dog sitters for our pup Vinnie. At just 6 months old, leaving him for the first time was a big deal for us, but we couldn’t have asked for better care. Vinnie absolutely loves it there – from enjoying their garden to walks in the nearby parks (he’s a bit of an outdoor park connoisseur!).

They really go the extra mile: offering a pet taxi service if you can’t drive, tailoring pick-up and drop-off times, and making sure each dog fits in well before socialising. Vinnie comes back happy, calm, and clearly loved – he never seems desperate to leave when we pick him up.

It’s such a relief to know we have reliable sitters we can trust, and we’ll definitely be using them for all our future holidays. Thank you Rich and Paula for giving Vinnie a true home away from home!

Milly has settled quickly into Happy Hound Haven. There is a large garden for her to explore and also plenty of room inside where enrichment activities are available. We particularly like the fact that there are only three dogs at a time and thought is given each day to match the size/needs of the all the dogs. This has been great as Milly can be nervous of large dogs . We look forward to the photos sent each time Milly visits as we can see she is really settled. It really is a home from home for her and it is clear Richard and Paula love looking after all the dogs. Highly recommended.

Happy Hound Haven is truly a home from home experience for our dog. I am usually very nervous about leaving him with anyone but he truly loves going and I can rest knowing he's having a great time. Richard and Paula send photos and updates regularly so I can see how he's doing.

Foxy has the best time ever with Richard.
He has so much fun and we trust him 100 percent.
We go on holiday and we know Foxy is in the best hands ever and we don't need to worry one bit.
We get daily pics of Foxy playing which always makes us smile.
I can highly recommend to everyone that this is the best place to leave your doggy.
It's an holiday for Foxy and he just loves staying here which is the most important thing..
I have used Happy Hound Haven a few times to look after my cats. Richard turns up on time and I have no issues to recommending him to friends and family.

Marley has been to stay with Richard and Paula for the day three times now and everytime he has loved it. They are so patient and kind and genuinely give the dogs so much care and attention, he never wants to leave! Being a rescue, he isn’t the most well socialised dog but they always pair him with dogs of the same energy levels and temperament and it allows him to make some doggy friends and have a day of fun away from us without us ever worrying. We would highly recommend them to anyone looking for care for their dog.
Fantastic, knowledgable, friendly people who have safety measures, great walking and fab comms. Would recommend to anyone, takes all the anxieties away that kennels bring

Happy Hound Haven provides a safe and welcoming home for their furry visitors.
They're such warm and friendly people. We love to receive their pup-dates whilst we are on holiday and will definitely use them again.

Lexi has been to stay 3 times now at the Happy Hound Haven. We could not ask for better care for our dog. She genuinely starts to get excited as we turn into the close. She always comes back to us happy and healthy.  It's great to be able to go away and not worry at all about Lexi. Can't recomend highly enough

Paula and Richard are such lovely people and their evident love for dogs is exactly what we needed for our golden Milo
Milo is not in a rush to leave when we go pick him up. We always get daily updates pictures and videos

100% recommending to anyone who wants to feel like their dogs are being cared for

Our lively 5 year old cocker spaniel Kali had her 1st proper stay at Happy Hound Haven at the end of May. She loved it,and bonded immediately with Richard. I really cannot rate them highly enough. We had regular pictures and updates throughout the stay.
Although it was Kali's first time boarding, she was settled and calm and clearly had a great time . Richard listened carefully to all our concerns and requirements and did everything we asked with a smile.
He was kindly accommodating to the unforseen circumstance of Kali arriving with stitches and a cone on her head. (We had of course immediately informed him of Kali's accident and discussed if it was still appropriate for her to come).
This really was a lovely, top class place for our dog.
Highly recommended.

My dog Boycie has stayed with this lovely couple a few times the last time it was for a week, he loves going and gets giddy when we turn into there street. They even set up a WhatsApp chat so they could keep in touch and send us pictures to see how he was getting on, I have added a few pics from last time he was there. He has been looked after extremely well and we would never use anyone else, you both are amazing thank you.

We have a 15 year old Jack Russel who is quite an anxious dog, and we were worried about leaving him with someone he didn’t know, but Mylo settled straight away after a trial ‘stop over’ and we knew then that Paula and Richard were the right people to look after our dog. He’s stayed twice now for 2 separate weeks and has been absolutely fine. There has always been regular photo updates and communication. Paula and Richard really do a fantastic job and have always taken great care of Mylo and his individual needs.

Wonderful couple, really love what they do and love your dogs like their own.  They get to know all about your dogs beforehand and stick as close as possible to your routine.  Lots of cuddles always available.

Thank you to Rich and Paula for taking care of my fur baby 😊
Good services and really nice people,
Highly recommended. …

Richard and Paula are wonderful dog sitters.  My cocker spaniel, Lola, loves going to spend time with them.  Lola gets excited and wagging tail as soon as she knows where she is going and having a great time with them two.  Each time they have updates and photos which is very much appreciated. Very flexible and very good with communication, great service. Highly recommended.

I recently took my dog to Happy Hound Haven, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The family were incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure each dog felt welcomed and loved. The facility is clean and well-organized, with plenty of space for playtime, both indoors and outdoors. My dog came home tired and happy, which is the best compliment I can give. I appreciate the daily updates and photos, allowing me to see how much fun they were having. I highly recommend Happy Hound Haven to any dog owner looking for a trustworthy daycare for their furry friend!
Great experience for our dog and peace of mind for us, updates and pictures during the stay of the pupper having a great time. Highly recommended
Richard and Paula welcomed my 7 month old spaniel into their home and provided an excellent and caring home from home stay and I  look forward to booking him in again soon.

Rich and Paula are fab dog sitters our spaniel Skye loves going to stay with them, they are very experienced and caring and also very good with communication we get loads of pics and updates during her stay.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We’ve been taking our dog, Rhys, to Happy Hound Haven in Rothwell, Leeds, and we couldn’t be happier with the care he receives! Rich and Paula genuinely love dogs, and it shows in everything they do. Rhys absolutely loves going there—he literally runs to the door with excitement every time we drop him off!

From the long countryside walks to the secure, dog-friendly garden, everything is set up to make dogs feel safe, happy, and right at home. It’s so reassuring to know that while we’re away, Rhys is not just being looked after but is having an amazing time.

Finding a trustworthy home dog boarding service in Leeds can be difficult, but Happy Hound Haven is the perfect choice. Rich and Paula provide expert care, plenty of exercise, and a loving home-from-home environment. If you’re looking for a reliable, professional, and caring place for your dog, I can’t recommend them highly enough!

5* service! I can’t thank Richard and Paula enough for taking care of my two border terriers. They welcomed my dogs into their home and treated them as if they were their own. It is clear they love dogs and are very caring.
I was given regular updates during my trip away and I would highly recommend to anyone who is looking for home boarding.

Thank you again
Very punctual, great with our dog. Very flexible and responsive with communication, great service.

It was our first experience of leaving Eddie with a dog boarder so we were a bit apprehensive at leaving him but we needn’t have been as he appeared to settle in well and Paula & Rich  took such excellent care of him, we were sent regular updates with photos and videos so we were reassured that Eddie was enjoying his holiday as much as we were enjoying ours ! We would be more than happy to recommend Happy Hound Haven and we’re sure Eddie would love to stay again.

I cannot recommend Happy Hound Haven enough! They took care of my nanna's timid cat, Snowflake, for a full month, and the experience was nothing short of fantastic. From the very beginning, Rich was incredibly friendly and attentive, putting my mind at ease about leaving Snowflake in someone else's care.

Rich took the time to understand Snowflake's complex needs, ensuring her needs were met.  It was clear that he genuinely cared about her well being and making her as comfortable as possible as she wasn’t used to been in the house.

If you're looking for a reliable and compassionate cat sitter, look no further than Happy Hound Haven. I would absolutely rebook their services without hesitation. If you have the chance to have them look after your pets, consider yourself lucky! Thank you, Happy Hound Haven, for taking such wonderful care of Snowflake!

I was looking for a dog boarders in my local area and came across Happy Hound Haven. I am so glad I did. My dog Monty loves it there! They have a great set up and he is so well looked after and happy when I pick him up. I wanted a home away from home for him and that's exactly what Happy Hound Haven is!

We have used Happy Hound Haven twice before and they have been excellent each time providing us with regular updates and taking fantastic care of our dog while we were away. Will definitely be using them again in the future!

Our Cocker Spaniel Bailey had a short break with Rich & Paula this weekend. He has been looked after so well and he’s definitely enjoyed his stay with them. I had regular updates with photos. I would highly recommend them. Thank you from Bev, Phil & Bailey 🐾 …

Richard and Paula are fabulous! Whether it's day care, overnighting or just a drop in they really care about our two Weimeraners.
